newsitem.title: USA: Triton Energy prices note purchase offer.
newsitem.headline: Triton Energy prices note purchase offer.

text.p: Triton Energy Ltd said the price on its previously announced offer to purchase all of Triton Energy Corp's outstanding Senior Subordinated Discount Notes due 1997 and 9 3/4 percent Senior Subordinated Discount Notes due 2000 has been determined.

The total consideration for each $1,000 principal amount of 1997 Notes shall be $970.00 and the total consideration for the 2000 Notes validly tendered shall be $1,067.76, in each case based on a payment date of May 2, plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but not including, such payment dates, it said.
Triton noted the total consideration includes a consent payment of $5.00 per $1,000 principal amount of notes for which a valid consent was received no later than April 18.

It said notes tendered after April 18, but prior to May 1, will receive the tender offer consideration of $965.00 for the 1997 Notes and $1,062.76 for the 2000 Notes, but not the consent payment. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
